Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Y.C. Verma, Sr. Advocate
 Mr. Madhav Raj, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Satya Nand Shukla, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order
2 30-09-2024 Heard Mr. Y.C. Verma, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. At the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he may be permitted to file supplementary affidavit as the sections have been wrongly mentioned in the paragraph 1 of the petition due to mistake.

3. The offences have been mentioned as Section 376 and 506 of the IPC whereas it should have been 341, 323, 498A and 494 of the IPC.
4.
Instead of permitting the petitioner to file supplementary affidavit, the petitioner is permitted to advance his argument on merits.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 29212 of 2024(2) dt.30-09-2024 5.
Issue notice to the O.P. No. 02 by both modes under registered cover A/D as well as ordinary process for which requisites etc., must be filed within one week from today.
